about: The fixtures (by file name) whose layout their profile changed after the frozen reference (conformance/zarrify/reference) froze, which it does not give: compare.py compares their outputs py with web alone, and the tests that compare the frozen profiles with the Rust core (python/tests/ir/ir_helpers.py, js/test/ir/ir.test.ts) leave them out. NDPI's strips without McuStarts whose frame header is not their level's size (spec/zarrify/ndpi.md §7 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/ndpi.md#7-ndpi-profile>) and its JPEG XR levels (spec/zarrify/ndpi.md §3 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/ndpi.md#3-levels>); TIFF's LZW images and images in strips (spec/zarrify/tiff.md §4.5 <https://github.com/d-v-b/refkv/blob/main/spec/zarrify/tiff.md#45-strips>).
